title: Martech Data Engineer
full_description:
At ING we are looking forMartechData Engineer
Your role and work environment:
We are looking for a talented and enthusiasticMartech Data Engineerto join ourEngagement FunnelTeam ofCustomer Interactions Tribe and Brand Experience CoE
The responsibility of this team is to implement a next gen Engagement funnel Platform stack, providing scalability and hyper-personalization to our customers,and our way of working is hybrid.
We operate according to a Biz-Dev Ops development process and strongly believe in the Agile approach delivering IT solutions. The focus is on high-quality mission-critical target-oriented development with regular milestones. Feature delivery is driven by the priorities determined by the Business and Product Owners, working on a day-to-day basis with the IT organization.
Your key responsibilities:
As a Martech Data Engineer you will:
Positively contribute to the successful migration of our legacy marketing automation platform to Adobe Experience Platform, ensuring minimal disruption and maximum business value.
Co-create innovative solutions with cross-functional teams to optimize marketing workflows and enhance customer engagement through advanced automation capabilities.
Ensure data integrity, system performance, and compliance throughout the migration process, while implementing best practices for scalability and future growth.
Provide technical guidance,maintenanceand support during implementation, testing, and post-migration phases.
What are we looking for?
Want to know if this job is made for you? These are some of the qualities that we value the most for this role. And if the shoe fits… don’t hesitate to apply!
The main challenges always addressed by our Martech Data engineer are:
To succed in the role, you should have…
•Consider the outcome of prioritization processes and related dependencies
•Coordination with other squads within ING, cross-domain
• Coordination with external data vendors
• Perform meaningful testing for several relevant goals
• Aim at improving time-to-market and added business value
• Implement new changes & deliver smart
•Be IT risk compliant
• Ability to express complex ideas about previous projects
• Commitment, ability, and aptitude for teamwork
•Agile mindset and experience working in cross-functional teams
•Engineering degree with a minimum of 5 years of experience
•Strong analytical, people management and communication skills
•Able to work in an autonomous way and to take initiative
•Loving to collaborate with different people
•Making things happen and ‘can do’ attitude
•DevOps and Agile culture
Proven track record and technical skills
•Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform knowledge,focused on Adobe RT-CDP
• Adobe XDM Data Modelling and E/Rmodellingknowledge
• Experience with relationaldatabases (Oracle) and SQL / PLSQL knowledge
•Data Engineering & Datamesh background
• Unix scripting & Python experience
• ETL & Functional Knowledge
• CI/CD: Azure DevOps experience
• Azure and/or other cloud environments
• Strong vendor experience with Testing (Unit, Integration, end-to-end, smoke)
•Best practices in testing
• Tagmanagerknowledge (Tealium,Adobe)
• Knowledge of analytics and reporting tools to measure marketing campaign performance.(e.g.Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Analytics)
• Basics on: Java, Spring, Microservices patterns and practices, Docker, Openshift/Kubernets.
• Event Driven architectural patterns
•Spark & PySparkknowledge
The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.
Check out what is waiting for you!
Be flexible my friend.
